//: Feature 32. The shaman's greeting, the always-available fallback (no StartingConditions, StartingPoint true). Listed after the four teach lines so a teach line wins while its conditions hold; otherwise the player gets this. Its one answer ends the dialog (NextStep 2 = DialogStep.ExitDialog). Trade is a separate thing (he is CannotTrade false); this dialog is only greeting and, once a spirit is bound, teaching.

Line.DefaultText: Well met, wanderer. I keep to the old roads and the old ways. I have dried mushrooms, fairyweed, a charm or two; trade if you like, and I will be on my way within the day.
